Trading is expected to commence on a split-adjusted basis at market open on Monday, June 10, 2024.

probe.label: COMPUTED
probe.derivation: The governing dividend record date is 2024-06-11. MEGA's projected settled position on that date is 180,000 post-split shares. At the governing post-split rate of $0.01 per share, gross cash is 180,000 × $0.01 = $1,800. No U.S. withholding applies to MEGA, a U.S.-domiciled fund, on the U.S.-source NVDA dividend, so net cash equals gross cash: $1,800, payable 2024-06-28.
